pages.title: Zeno Anchor
pages.text: A quantum system watched closely enough never changes: each look resets it (the quantum Zeno effect). The anchor watches its chunk the same way, and the chunk cannot unload. Powered, it keeps the 3 x 3 chunks round it loaded and working, whether or not anyone is near. It draws 64 FE a tick. Made by crafting.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Quantum Entanglement.
